title: Bimbisara
exam_points: Buddha aur Mahavira ka samkalin; vaivahik sambandhon (Kosaladevi, Chellana, Khema) se rajya badhaya.
Anga ko jeet kar Magadh mein milaya; Brahmadatta ko haraya.
Rajvaidya Jivaka inke darbar mein the; Ajatashatru ne inhe kaid kiya.

mcqs.q: Bimbisara ne kis rajya ko jeet kar Magadh mein milaya?
